001: Are you going to the college's June festival on Saturday?
Yes, I am. I think it's going to be a lot of fun.
That's great! I'm helping out at the food stall.
Really? Then I'll stop by to say hi.
You can, I'll be over by the baked goods section.
Deal, I'll bring my friends along too.
002: Have you bought your ticket for tomorrow's lecture yet?
Not yet, but I heard the spots are running out.
Yeah, the room is small and a lot of people signed up.
Then I'll buy it now on the university website.
Good idea, tell me what you thought afterwards.
Sure, if you want, we can go together.
003: What are you going to present at science week?
Rafael and I are going to show our robotics project.
That's cool! Have you finished everything?
Almost, we just need to adjust a few details on the prototype.
If you need help, just call me.
Thanks, Fernanda! We might actually need it.
004: Did you see the lineup for the music festival?
I did, there are some really cool bands playing on Saturday.
I really wanted to go, but I don't have anyone to go with.
You can go with me and Beatriz, we're going at night.
Wow, really? That would be great!
It's settled then, we'll figure out the time later.
005: The book fair organizers are asking for volunteers.
I saw the poster, but I don't know if I have the time.
It's just one afternoon, I think it's worth participating.
Are you going to sign up too?
Yes, I am. We can be on the same shift.
Okay then, you convinced me. I'll sign up today.
006: Have you picked your costume for the costume party yet?
Not yet, I'm torn between two options.
Tell me what they are, maybe I can help.
One is a movie character and the other is a superhero.
I'd go with the superhero, it suits you better.
Yeah, I think you're right. I'll go with that then.
007: The college scavenger hunt is next week.
I know, my team is already practicing the challenges.
That's cool! Which challenge do you guys like the most?
We love the treasure hunt around campus.
That's the best part, everyone joins in.
Yeah, it's going to be really competitive this year.
008: Are you going to the dance performance at the student center?
I am, my cousin is one of the dancers in the group.
That's awesome! I really want to watch it too.
We can go together, I was going with two more friends.
Perfect, then we can meet at the entrance.
Deal, I'll text you before I head out.
009: Do you know if registration for the chess tournament has opened?
Yes, it has. I saw it on the university website today.
Are you going to participate too?
I am, but I admit I'm a bit rusty.
Relax, the important thing is to have fun and practice.
That's true, and it's also a chance to meet new people.
010: Are you going to help organize the graduation ceremony?
I really want to, but my schedule is pretty packed.
We only meet once a week.
Oh, then I think I can fit it in.
That's great! The first meeting is on Thursday.
Perfect, I'll show up and see how I can help.
